NHDD

Runtime DEX / SO capture for rooted Android. No in-process injection.

Download · Usage · Design · 简体中文

## What it does - Captures resident DEX across rounds, with coverage, holes and content revisions. - Discovers DEX through supported ART object layouts; safely combines short-lived method windows with provenance and conflict detection. - Reconstructs ELF32/64 SO files using PT_LOAD and load bias. - Supports cold launch, package process following, tracefs events and incremental maps scanning. - Preserves CompactDex / VDEX / OAT evidence, including OAT 279; provides offline structural checks. - Offers a standalone Android CLI, a Python TUI and a Windows desktop GUI. Controllers do not expose every advanced CLI option. ## Quick start Download the matching package from Releases and check SHA256SUMS.txt. The main device target is ARM64, built for API 34+. ADB, Root and permission to read the target process are required. ~~~bash adb shell "su -c id" adb push nhdd /data/local/tmp/nhdd adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/nhdd adb shell "su -c '/data/local/tmp/nhdd com.example.app /data/local/tmp/nhdd_run01 --all --watch 3'" adb pull /data/local/tmp/nhdd_run01 ./nhdd_run01 ~~~ Replace com.example.app with your own or explicitly authorized app. Use a fresh output directory: default runs may clear earlier artifacts. See the [full guide](./NHDD-cpp-modular/README.md) for ART, spawn, event modes and output semantics. ## Interface ### Windows GUI ![NHDD desktop GUI](./NHDD-cpp-modular/assets/screenshots/gui.png) Built GUI frontend in a browser preview, before connecting a device; no private device identifiers or dumps are shown. This does not substitute for native WebView2 testing. ### Python TUI ![NHDD TUI live progress dashboard](./NHDD-cpp-modular/assets/screenshots/tui.svg) App selection → configuration → live watch dashboard → results. Install rich and run `python nhdd_tui.py`, or select a target directly with `python nhdd_tui.py com.example.app`.
App selection and configuration ![NHDD TUI app selection and configuration](./NHDD-cpp-modular/assets/screenshots/tui-setup.svg)
Both TUI views use the real Rich UI functions with synthetic packages, input and logs—not Root device results. Reproduce them with `python scripts/capture_tui.py`. ## Architecture ~~~mermaid flowchart LR UI["TUI / GUI"] -->|"ADB + su"| CLI["Root C++ CLI"] CLI --> CAP["Fast capture / DEX-SO-JNI scans"] APP["App memory / ART"] -->|"External reads"| CAP EV["tracefs / maps diff"] --> CAP CAP --> CHECK["Identity / coverage / format checks"] CHECK --> REC["PT_LOAD rebuild / safe ART merge"] REC --> OUT["DEX / SO / metadata / timeline"] ~~~ The scanner runs outside the target app. Checks are path-specific; recovered method composites are recorded as cross-time evidence, not atomic snapshots. [Implementation and safety boundaries](./NHDD-cpp-modular/docs/design.md). ## Packages and documentation | Component | Start here | |---|---| | Android CLI | [Features, commands and outputs](./NHDD-cpp-modular/README.md) | | Python TUI | Install Python 3.10+ and rich; run nhdd_tui.py | | Windows GUI | ADB + WebView2 Runtime; keep the bundled Android engine beside the EXE | | Build / security | [Build notes](./BUILD_WINDOWS.md) · [Dependency audit](./NHDD-cpp-modular/docs/dependency-security.md) | ARMv7 is cross-compiled only; 16KiB-page devices are not validated. ART recovery requires a supported Build ID, and short windows can still be missed. No-hook is not undetectable; structural validity is not proof of decrypted methods or a runnable APK. [MIT](./LICENSE). Third-party notices are preserved. Project: [Fruit-Guardians/NHDD](https://github.com/Fruit-Guardians/NHDD). Authorized research and your own apps only.

NHDD

Runtime DEX / SO capture for rooted Android. No in-process injection.

Download ·

Usage ·

Design ·

简体中文

What it does

  • Captures resident DEX across rounds, with coverage, holes and content revisions.
  • Discovers DEX through supported ART object layouts; safely combines short-lived method windows with provenance and conflict detection.
  • Reconstructs ELF32/64 SO files using PT_LOAD and load bias.
  • Supports cold launch, package process following, tracefs events and incremental maps scanning.
  • Preserves CompactDex / VDEX / OAT evidence, including OAT 279; provides offline structural checks.
  • Offers a standalone Android CLI, a Python TUI and a Windows desktop GUI. Controllers do not expose every advanced CLI option.

    • Quick start

    Download the matching package from Releases and check SHA256SUMS.txt. The main device target is ARM64, built for API 34+. ADB, Root and permission to read the target process are required.

    ~~~bash

    adb shell "su -c id"

    adb push nhdd /data/local/tmp/nhdd

    adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/nhdd

    adb shell "su -c '/data/local/tmp/nhdd com.example.app /data/local/tmp/nhdd_run01 --all --watch 3'"

    adb pull /data/local/tmp/nhdd_run01 ./nhdd_run01

    ~~~

    Replace com.example.app with your own or explicitly authorized app. Use a fresh output directory: default runs may clear earlier artifacts. See the full guide for ART, spawn, event modes and output semantics.

    Interface

    Windows GUI

    !NHDD desktop GUI

    Built GUI frontend in a browser preview, before connecting a device; no private device identifiers or dumps are shown. This does not substitute for native WebView2 testing.

    Python TUI

    !NHDD TUI live progress dashboard

    App selection → configuration → live watch dashboard → results. Install rich and run python nhdd_tui.py, or select a target directly with python nhdd_tui.py com.example.app.

    App selection and configuration

    !NHDD TUI app selection and configuration

    Both TUI views use the real Rich UI functions with synthetic packages, input and logs—not Root device results. Reproduce them with python scripts/capture_tui.py.

    Architecture

    ~~~mermaid

    flowchart LR

    UI["TUI / GUI"] -->|"ADB + su"| CLI["Root C++ CLI"]

    CLI --> CAP["Fast capture / DEX-SO-JNI scans"]

    APP["App memory / ART"] -->|"External reads"| CAP

    EV["tracefs / maps diff"] --> CAP

    CAP --> CHECK["Identity / coverage / format checks"]

    CHECK --> REC["PT_LOAD rebuild / safe ART merge"]

    REC --> OUT["DEX / SO / metadata / timeline"]

    ~~~

    The scanner runs outside the target app. Checks are path-specific; recovered method composites are recorded as cross-time evidence, not atomic snapshots. Implementation and safety boundaries.

    Packages and documentation

    | Component | Start here |

    |---|---|

    | Android CLI | Features, commands and outputs |

    | Python TUI | Install Python 3.10+ and rich; run nhdd_tui.py |

    | Windows GUI | ADB + WebView2 Runtime; keep the bundled Android engine beside the EXE |

    | Build / security | Build notes · Dependency audit |

    ARMv7 is cross-compiled only; 16KiB-page devices are not validated. ART recovery requires a supported Build ID, and short windows can still be missed. No-hook is not undetectable; structural validity is not proof of decrypted methods or a runnable APK.

    MIT. Third-party notices are preserved. Project: Fruit-Guardians/NHDD. Authorized research and your own apps only.
